In the distance beyond the ruins lies a hazy horizon where smoke curls faintly into the gray sky—an ominous reminder of abandonment or conflict just out of view.

The camera remains static but angled sharply upward, forcing us to witness not only her physical strength—but also the quiet intensity etched onto her face: eyes sharp, gaze unwavering, lips pressed together in silent resolve. There's no fear visible here—it’s raw determination masked behind calm composure.
